text: {"assertions":["A NaN feature bug was discovered in ml/features/encoder.py on 2026-04-03 affecting the ML pipeline.","The bug occurred only for accounts in the 5% rollout bucket.","The root cause was an off-by-one error in a slice bound.","The fix was implemented in PR #5410 on branch fix/nan-feature-1 with an added property test.","The bug could be reproduced by encoding a batch holding the sparse column in Python.","The fix eliminated 36 duplicate rows per day from being written.","Test coverage for the encoder is located in tests/ml/test_encoder.py."]}
